text: Long catch-up with Ifeoma over coffee. She and Karan got engaged in Lisbon last month, ring was his grandmother's. Wedding pencilled in for 14 June next year, probably in Lagos. Her mum is already planning the guest list. Need to send them a proper card.
Lucy rang. Her and Tom's tenth anniversary is October 28th and he's booked Kyoto as a surprise. She's not supposed to know. Flight is 13 hours and she hates flying.
Pick up dry cleaning before Thursday. Passport renewal form still on the desk.
Laila says the Bali trip is off, Henrik couldn't get the time off work. They're doing a long weekend in Cornwall instead, 3rd to 6th of November. She sounded gutted.

Esme's sister Sophie is getting married 22/05 in Tuscany. Esme is maid of honour and properly nervous about the speech. Offered to read a draft. Don't forget to ask her how the dress fitting went on Saturday.
Antoine back from Montreal. Says the flight home was delayed nine hours and he slept on the floor at Heathrow. His dad is moving out there for good in spring.

Farah and Colm celebrating 25 years on 2 December. Their kids are throwing a party at the cricket club. I'm doing the cake. Farah drops hints about wanting a weekend in Paris, so maybe chip in with the others.
Must book the car's MOT, due 30 Oct.

Met Sana at the school gate. Her brother Eduardo just proposed to his girlfriend Gemma on top of Table Mountain, she said yes. Sana is flying out to Cape Town for the engagement party on March 8th. Their mum cried for an hour apparently.
Ben's wedding to Asha was beautiful. Quick note: send them the photos from the ceremony, and ask Ben how the honeymoon in Sri Lanka was once they're back on the 9th.
Irina mentioned she's doing a solo trip to Japan in April, three weeks, rail pass. First time travelling alone and a bit anxious. Her partner Alejandro can't come because of his PhD deadline.
Grocery run tonight, need oat milk and bin bags. Gym 7am tomorrow.

Louis called about Rana's 40th. Surprise dinner, Saturday 15 Nov, at that Lebanese place on the high street. Rana is vegetarian, he's sorting a set menu. I said I'd bring the card round for everyone to sign. Louis's daughter is making a banner.

Thomas and Meera just got back from their honeymoon in Peru. Meera got altitude sickness in Cusco and spent two days in bed but says Machu Picchu was worth it. They're doing a belated reception on 7th Dec for people who couldn't make the wedding. Thomas wants me to DJ, need to decide by Friday. Also, Meera's dad had his knee op while they were away, should text her to see how he's recovering.
Andre's parents renewing their vows in Goa, January 12th. Whole family flying from Toronto.

Caroline's flight to Auckland is tomorrow night, 24 hours door to door. She's visiting her nan Kiri, who turns 90 on 1/11. Caroline is bringing her a framed photo of the old farm. Remind me to message her when she lands.
Coffee with Alina. She's started at the travel agency on Baker Street, loves it. Her husband Jakub just got made redundant though, and she's worried about money. Check in with her next week.
Efua told me she and Heather have split up. Heather has moved back to Edinburgh. Efua seems okay-ish, throwing herself into marathon training for the Berlin race on 27/09.
Erin's engagement party is on the 16th of August, garden do at her parents'. Fiancé is Luis, met him once, nice guy, works in aviation. Erin wants a vintage record player apparently, file that away.
Note to self: renew travel insurance before 1 December. Order euros. Check whether the Dublin flight allows a cabin bag.

Spent the afternoon with Karan. He's flying to Delhi on Nov 3rd for his cousin's wedding, a full week of events. His mum wants him to bring someone. He's still not over Ifeoma breaking off the engagement, honestly. I should take him for a pint before he goes.
Lucy's daughter Esme passed her driving test this morning! Lucy's buying her a little Fiat. Must send Esme a congrats message.
Sophie and Antoine celebrate their first anniversary on the 5th. He's planning a dinner at the place they had their first date. She's coeliac so he's checking the menu.

Henrik messaged from Oslo. The job move went through, he starts at the Bergen office 6 January. Laila is staying in London until the flat sells. Long distance for a few months, they both seem fine with it. Henrik's dog Bjørn is going with him.
Laila nervous about her citizenship interview on February 19th. Text her good luck the night before.
Haircut moved to Wednesday. Need to drop the parcel at the post office too.

Ran into Colm at the station. His daughter Gemma graduated from Galway last week, first class in marine biology. She's off to Australia for a year on a working visa, leaves 2nd January. Colm put on a brave face but you could tell he's dreading it.

Sana's wedding has been called off. She and Andre are taking a break. The honeymoon to the Maldives was non-refundable so she's going with her best mate Rana instead, 11 to 21 March. Need to call her this weekend.
Phone call with Eduardo, sorry, Eddie. His in-laws are visiting from Brazil for six weeks from December 10. Already stressed about where everyone will sleep.
Asha's grandparents' 60th wedding anniversary is 4/12. The family's hiring a hall in Leicester. Asha asked me to help with the slideshow, I'm doing that on the weekend of the 22nd.
Irina loves botanical gardens. Visited Kew four times this year. Thinking she'd like the RHS membership for her birthday.
Ben's brother Thomas proposed to his boyfriend in Santorini. Ben was there filming it. They're thinking of a small wedding next summer, possibly 21st June. Ask Ben for the video.

Caught up with Alejandro and Irina at the pub. They're finally booked for Peru, flying out 14 May, back June 2nd. Alejandro has been learning Spanish properly, which is funny since his parents are Argentinian. Irina's mum is looking after their cat Pepper. They want to come round for dinner before they go, so I need to suggest a date.
Meera's sister Rana is due in March. Baby shower is 1st of February, I said I'd go.
Louis Bianchi from work is retiring on 19 December after 30 years. Leaving do at the Crown that Friday. Collection going round, chip in by the 12th.
Book flights to Rome. Prices drop Tuesdays apparently. Need to be back by 3rd Nov for the boiler engineer.

Andre called. He got the job in Singapore, starts March 1st. His wife Caroline is thrilled, kids less so. Their son is starting secondary school out there. Andre wants to do a goodbye barbecue before they leave, maybe mid-February. Send him the contact for the shipping company we used.
Kiri and her husband Luis are flying to Vancouver for their 30th anniversary, leaving 7/10. Kiri hates long flights so she's trying the compression socks I suggested.
Heather texted. Her mum's surgery went well yesterday. Heather is staying with her in Leeds until Sunday. I'll pop round with soup once she's back.

Jakub (Kuba to everyone) is doing the Camino in May with his uncle. Six weeks walking. His girlfriend Erin thinks he's mad. He's been training on weekends and his knees are already complaining. He asked if he could borrow my walking poles, need to dig them out of the loft.

Efua's parents' 40th anniversary party is on October 25th in Accra. She's flying out the 22nd. Her brother Colm can't get leave so she's making a video message for him to send. She asked what to get them, I suggested an engraved photo frame.
Sophie's hen do is in Barcelona, 10th-12th April. Esme is organising and already stressing about the group chat. I've paid the deposit.

Gemma rang about Farah's wedding dress fitting, which went badly, needs taking in. Wedding's 30 August so plenty of time. Farah is quite stressed with the seating plan, her stepdad and her real dad aren't speaking.
Car insurance renewal is 12/11. Compare quotes this weekend.

Alina told me Henrik and Laila had a little ceremony at the registry office on Friday! Only parents there. Proper party next summer in Norway. Henrik's mum made the cake. Should send a card and maybe a bottle of something.
Thomas Schmidt from the running club has a big trip coming, cycling from Munich to Venice in September. His wife Ifeoma is driving the support van.
Dr Gupta, Meera's dad, is flying back to Chennai on Dec 15 to see his brother, who's very unwell. Meera is worried. Check in with her after he's gone.

Nice long lunch with Asha and Karan. Asha's off to Iceland for the northern lights on 8 February with her sister. Karan just booked Morocco for Easter, he's surfing. Neither of them can believe I've never been abroad in winter. Karan's sister Laila got engaged on Sunday to her uni boyfriend, wedding next autumn. Asha gave me the name of a good travel agent. Got to look into it.
Walked the dog, sorted the recycling, booked the dentist for 2 Dec.
Antoine and his partner Louis are hosting a housewarming on November 22nd. They moved into the Clapham flat in September. Louis wants plants, Antoine wants nothing because they have no space.

Lucy Williams, old flatmate, messaged out of the blue. She's in Melbourne now, married, two kids. Coming back to the UK for her brother's wedding on 3rd of July and wants to meet up. Reply to her this week.
Erin's flight to Toronto got cancelled so her trip to see her grandad is pushed to next month. He's 92 and not great. She's been on the phone to the airline all morning. Ring her tonight.
Sana's anniversary with Ben is 9 Sept. Last year he forgot. This year she's dropping hints about a pottery class for two.
Booked the Edinburgh trip myself: train up on 14/12, two nights, back the 16th. Need to sort a cat sitter.
Ifeoma loves Nigerian highlife, has a huge vinyl collection. Doesn't drink. Lives near Brixton market.
Colm and Heather married twenty years in March. Planning a trip to Iceland for it. Heather is terrified of flying but determined. Colm asked me not to mention the volcano thing.

Quick call with Rana. Her cousin Meera's wedding in Hyderabad is December 27th, five days of events. Rana's flying out on Christmas Eve with her husband Andre and the kids, a 10-hour flight with a toddler. She's dreading the jetlag. Andre is giving a speech in Telugu which he's been practising for weeks. Remind me to wish them a safe flight.
Passport photos done. Visa appointment for the US trip is 4th November, 9.30am, bring bank statements.

Eduardo and Gemma's wedding in Seville was incredible. Eduardo cried through his vows. Meant to ask how the flamenco lesson the day before went. They're off to Mexico for the honeymoon next Monday, back on the 18th.

Farah said Colm's been struggling since his mum died in August. He hasn't left the house much. His sister Heather is staying with him for now. Must give him a ring tomorrow, maybe suggest a walk on Sunday.
